meaning:
ἀπ-ορφανίζω
(ἀπό, ὀρφανός),
to be bereaved (prop., of a parent, Lft., Notes, 36); metaphorically, 1Th.2:17 (where Field thinks it = χωρισθέντες, Notes, 199).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season, in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,
